band.doc: Filter band this source was observed with.

dec.doc: Declination coordinate of the position of the DiaObject [deg].

detector.doc: Id of the detector where this forcedSource was measured. Datatype short instead of byte because of DB concerns about unsigned bytes.

diaObjectId.doc: Id of the DiaObject that this DiaForcedSource was associated with.

midpointMjdTai.doc: Effective mid-visit time for this diaForcedSource, expressed as Modified Julian Date, International Atomic Time [d].

ra.doc: Right ascension coordinate of the position of the DiaObject [deg].

scienceFlux.doc: Forced photometry flux for a point source model measured on the visit image centered at the DiaObject position [nJy].

timeProcessedMjdTai.doc: Time when this record was generated, expressed as Modified Julian Date, International Atomic Time.

timeWithdrawnMjdTai.doc: Time when this record was marked invalid, expressed as Modified Julian Date, International Atomic Time.

visit.doc: Id of the visit where this forcedSource was measured.
